title: Merge Expertise And Compact Into Driver Configuration Mechanism
description: Merge the existing "expertise" (beginner/normal/expert) and "compact" UI preferences into a single new "driver" configuration mechanism. A driver is a named bundle of explicit presentation axes: labels (full/icons), labelTier (beginner/normal wording), drag (handle/surface), chrome reveal (always/hover), gumball reveal (always/hover), tooltips (full/minimal/none). Ship two built-in drivers, "default" and "compact", fully replacing expertise+compact end to end (storage, state, settings UI, commands, i18n, Rust wgpu mirror). Allow users to create their own custom drivers via a structured settings editor, mirroring the existing custom-themes mechanism. Remove expertise/compact entirely — no compat layer, no migration (greenfield repo).
summary: Merged the "expertise" (beginner/normal/expert) and "compact" UI preferences into a single "driver" configuration mechanism. A driver is a named bundle of explicit presentation axes: labels (full/icons), labelTier (beginner/normal wording), drag (handle/surface), chrome/gumball reveal (always/hover), tooltips (full/minimal/none). Shipped two built-in drivers (default, compact) plus a structured settings editor for user-created custom drivers, mirroring the existing custom-themes mechanism. Added a new pointer/focus-based chrome hover-reveal controller (data-ui-reveal-region + data-ui-revealed) driving navbar/footer visibility under the compact driver, and wired drag-surface behavior through all three drag mechanisms (native HTML5 tree drag, dnd-kit sortable rows, pointer-capture pane/tab drags) so compact mode makes whole elements draggable with no grip handle. Removed expertise/compact entirely — enum, storage keys, React context/providers, settings UI, commands, i18n keys — with no compatibility shim, plus mirrored the change in the Rust wgpu renderer (driver_id replacing compact_mode/expertise, os.setDriver command) and fixed a stale `theme:` field bug in animate/present's DEFAULT_SURFACE_CHROME along the way. Verified via a full-repo `tsc --noEmit` pass (found and fixed one real bug — a wrong i18n key path — zero other driver-related errors) and repeated repo-wide greps confirming no dead expertise/compact references remain outside unrelated technologies (compose, architect) that coincidentally use the word "expertise" for their own domain concepts. Could not get a clean live browser/vitest run in this session: the whole workspace's generated-icons asset (metabolism_icons.ts) and several unrelated subsystems (three.js types, IntroductionGesture, styling readonly props) currently fail to build/typecheck due to concurrent work from other sessions — confirmed unrelated by filtering all typecheck/vitest output for driver/expertise/compact and finding nothing.
